# PF-0123 addendum — folder picker (owner, 2026-11-11)

Redesign and improve the existing folder picker within Phase 5. Preserve the current identity. Modern, intuitive explorer without complexity: breadcrumb navigation and back/up; search/filter folders; recently used projects or locations; clearly distinguish existing YallaFlow projects, existing codebases (Laravel, Node.js, etc.) and empty folders; show the selected folder's full path and allow safe manual path entry; support creating a new folder when creating a project; obvious selected folder and primary confirmation; smooth keyboard navigation, focus, scrolling, Arabic RTL, English LTR, macOS/Linux. Avoid unnecessary modals, nested panels or technical information. Use the same picker wherever YallaFlow asks for a project folder; for existing projects connect to the init preview and confirmation; for new projects preserve the creation plan's destination validation, path safety and existing-folder protections. Review src/console/folders.js and the picker UI in resources/console/app.js. Do not weaken path validation, symlink protections or directory access restrictions; if a feature conflicts with security rules, propose the safest usable alternative. Acceptance: a first-time user finds, selects or creates the intended project location quickly without terminal commands or understanding the filesystem structure. Keep within Phase 5 unless a dependency requires otherwise. No commit, push, tag, publish or unrelated modifications without explicit approval.
